title: Twenty-Two in Alexandria: Riding DMV Transit, Senator James West's White House Tickets, & The Spark to Run for City Council
description: Invited up to Alexandria by Dad for a week-long twenty-second birthday trip—taking a taxi van to Newport News Station and riding the ARTS train to ALX—Katie and Nate explore Northern Virginia's buses and trains, tour the White House and the U.S. Senate Gallery courtesy of newly sworn-in U.S. Senator James West, and discover how to run for Virginia Beach City Council after realizing the last bus home from City Hall leaves thirty minutes before 6:00 PM Council meetings even start.
